question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"referred."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"referred"** means to mention or direct someone to a particular person or thing. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के विषय में उल्‍लेख या चर्चा करना) • **Example**: *When he said ‘some students’, he **referred**__ to us.* • It is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank in the given sentence. • The correct answer is Option 4. • **Correct passage**: The average weather in a location over several years is __**referred**__ to as the climate. Climate change is characterised by a ______ (2) ______ in those average circumstances. The fast climate change we are presently witnessing is the result of humans' ______ (3) ______ of oil, gas, and coal in their homes, industry, and transportation. When these fossil fuels are ______ (4) ______, they emit greenhouse gases, mostly carbon dioxide (CO2). These gases capture the Sun's heat, raising the planet's ______ (5) ______.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1, **"known"**, means to have knowledge or awareness about something or someone. (किसी बात या व्‍यक्ति की जानकारी होना) • Option 2, **"said"**, means to utter words or speak aloud. (शब्‍दों की सहायता से) (किसी को कुछ) कहना; बोलना) • Option 3, **"called"**, means to give a name to someone or something. (ऊँची आवाज़ में बुलाना, पुकारना, चिल्‍लाना (प्रायः ध्यान आकर्षित करने के लिए)) 98:T10e6, The correct answer is **"shift."**
